in_hindi.name: Shambhavi
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of the Universe
in_hindi.long_meaning: Shambhavi एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Shambhavi is a Sanskrit and Hindu name meaning 'Goddess of the Universe'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shambhu', which means 'Benevolent God'. Shambhavi is a representation of the divine feminine and embodies the qualities of gentleness, strength, peace, and prosperity.
